ننهرس (form VII)
# نَنْهَرِسُ (nanharisu) /nan.ha.ri.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
# نَنْهَرِسَ (nanharisa) /nan.ha.ri.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
# نَنْهَرِسْ (nanharis) /nan.ha.ris/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
